intent: A size quiz that ends in the dark: three eye silhouettes side by side (a whale's is smaller than a bird's), a pin on the Ross Sea where the biggest one was hauled up, a depth counter dropping a kilometre, and the reason the eyes are so big — spotting a sperm whale coming.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Which creature has the most ENORMOUS eyes?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Which creature has the most enormous eyes?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat
lines.text: Blue whale, Ostrich, or Colossal squid?
The colossal squid. Its eyes are about 27 centimetres across, wider than any other animal's.

lines.direction: ease back over New Zealand; three eye silhouettes rise on 'ostrich' — a small disc, a mid disc, the squid's football; a brain sticker on 'brain'; a whale sticker on 'whale' as New Zealand pulses on '15'
lines.text: An ostrich eye is 5 centimetres, wider than its brain. A blue whale manages only 15.

lines.direction: ease back so the sea south of the islands is in frame; a hook sticker on 'record'; from 'Ross' a ship route draws in from the bottom edge with the ship riding it north to Wellington, the Ross Sea tag plated by the route's start; the Wellington pin lands on 'museum' with a museum sticker as New Zealand pulses
lines.text: The record animal came up on a fishing line in the Ross Sea in 2007. It sits in a Wellington museum.

lines.direction: tighten on the South Island; the depth counter runs 0 → 1,000 metres from 'huge'; a moon sticker on 'dark'; a whale sticker on 'sperm'; a soft pulse on 'closing'; the pin leaves at the end
lines.text: Why so huge? A kilometre down, in the dark, they spot a sperm whale closing in.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: Eyes as wide as a football. Follow us.
